title: DEMONSTRATION / SYNTHETIC — Air-vortex experiment import template
data_origin: hand-authored synthetic rows for loader and GUI adapter tests
purpose: software interface demonstration only; not a physical experiment

observable_definitions.surface_depth: mean(corrected surface samples for r>=0.8R) minus min(corrected surface samples for r<=stir-bar half-length)
observable_definitions.min_gap_to_bar: minimum geometrical gap from the top-connected gas-liquid interface over the bar footprint to the bar surface
observable_definitions.bar_speed: measured stir-bar angular-speed magnitude; imported to SI rad/s; rotation direction belongs in run metadata
observable_definitions.connectivity_fraction: per-row connected score in [0,1]; these demonstration rows use single-frame 0/1 values
observable_definitions.local_air_core_radius: equivalent radius of the top-connected gas cross-section at the frozen local plane
observable_definitions.local_relative_speed: magnitude of local liquid-gas relative velocity at the air-core boundary on the same frozen plane; unavailable if gas velocity is not measured

below_detection_limit_policy: local_air_core_radius is encoded as zero only when the top-connected gas component does not intersect the frozen plane
warning: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION. Do not fit, score, validate, or quote these values as measurements. Copy the schema into new files, replace every row and provenance field with real synchronized measurements, and assign sealed_validation only before opening a preregistered blind dataset.
notes: The schema role remains calibration solely because the strict loader accepts calibration or sealed_validation. evidence_status=DEMONSTRATION overrides any scientific eligibility. bar_speed is actual measured bar speed, never the panel command.
